changelog: Grade 12 Question Bank, Quizzes & Worksheets complete layout and mathematical typesetting audit: verified adaptive choices layout (4-col, 2-col A B / C D, and 1-col A / B / C / D) across all 1045 questions in Grade 12 Question Bank (504 4-col, 433 2-col, 108 1-col); confirmed zero math errors, zero raw slashes, and zero unbalanced dollars across question_bank.json, point_quizzes.json, and worksheets.json; verified flawless rendering and zero text collisions in Headless Chrome CDP.
